prompt: Review whether Uber has a material causal relationship to mobility-platform network economics and autonomous-vehicle transition risk.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Uber can monetize demand aggregation, dispatch, payments and utilization across human-driven and autonomous supply if partners value marketplace distribution more than vertical integration.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or reverse the edge if autonomous fleets bypass Uber, trip growth stops producing incremental cash, or regulation, insurance, incentives, dilution and investment consume the marketplace benefit.
